name: @erp/web
//react-router-dom: Keep this on the newest 7.x. React Router has a long advisory history and the ONLY safe direction is forward: 7.11.0 carries fourteen advisories (XSS via open redirects, RCE via vendored turbo-stream, DoS via route matching, CSRF in action processing), and 7.18.0 is the first release that clears all of them. One advisory still applies to 7.18.2 - GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2, a CSRF bypass in RSC mode - and no published version fixes it, since its range runs to 8.2.0 and no 8.x is on npm. It is unreachable here: this is a client-rendered SPA with no server components and no server actions, so the RSC request path never executes. Do not 'fix' the audit warning by downgrading; that trades one unreachable issue for fourteen live ones.
